Camera degli Sposi.fact: The Camera degli Sposi ("bridal chamber"), sometimes called the Camera picta ("painted chamber"), is a room frescoed with illusionistic paintings by Andrea Mantegna in the Ducal Palace, Mantua, Italy. Camera Link.fact: Camera Link is a serial communication protocol standard designed for camera interface applications based on the National Semiconductor interface Channel-link.
